definitions.explanation: An emperor who has abdicated the throne. The formal title for a Japanese emperor after retirement, reinstated in 2019 when Emperor Akihito abdicated.

examples.japanese: {上皇|じょうこう}が{退位|たいい}された。
examples.english: The Emperor Emeritus abdicated the throne.

examples.japanese: {上皇|じょうこう}{陛下|へいか}は{現在|げんざい}{御所|ごしょ}にお{住|す}まいである。
examples.english: His Majesty the Emperor Emeritus currently resides in the Imperial Palace.

examples.japanese: ２０１９{年|ねん}の{退位|たいい}により、{約|やく}２００{年|ねん}ぶりに{上皇|じょうこう}という{称号|しょうごう}が{復活|ふっかつ}した。
examples.english: Due to the 2019 abdication, the title of Emperor Emeritus was revived for the first time in about 200 years.

notes:
The official title given to a Japanese emperor after abdication. Used with the honorific suffix {陛下|へいか} (His/Her Majesty) when referring to the current holder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上皇|じょうこう}{陛下|へいか}: His Majesty the Emperor Emeritus
- {上皇|じょうこう}{后|ごう}: Empress Emerita (wife of Emperor Emeritus)
- {上皇|じょうこう}になる: to become Emperor Emeritus

ETYMOLOGY:
The title was last used in 1817. It was revived in 2019 when Emperor Akihito abdicated in favor of his son. Distinguished from related historical titles like {太上天皇|だいじょうてんのう} (the older formal form).

HOMOPHONES (different kanji):
- {乗降|じょうこう}: getting on and off (a vehicle)
- {条項|じょうこう}: clause, article (of a contract)
